reason: When I am at my other work I have no idea what cash came in or which bills got cancelled, and seeing the drawer amount and attendance from my phone is exactly what I lose sleep over. Since the first month is free, I will try it and judge it by whether the numbers match the drawer.
objection: My stylists will not bother to enter every walk-in on a packed Sunday or festival week, and then I am paying ₹999 every month, slow months too, for half-filled data plus ₹4,999 already gone on setup.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month my staff are still skipping bills on busy days, or the cash check does not match my drawer, I will cancel.
